description: NaInI₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent InI₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaI₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent InI₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.16-3.31 Å. In is bonded to four I atoms to form InI₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-66°. There are two shorter (2.72 Å) and two longer (2.77 Å) In-I bond lengths. There are four inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one In atom. In the second I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one In atom. In the third I site, I is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one In atom. In the fourth I site, I is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one In atom.
